what: Plan keys tier success off process rc, but current CI launchers exit 0 and report real tool failure only as LAUNCHER_EXIT
scenario_or_breakage: Model failure or missing binary is treated as tier success, so the waterfall never reaches Codex/Claude and ship-pr proceeds into post-success commit/push flow
suggested_fix: Have run_ci_fix_vendor parse LAUNCHER_EXIT from the captured launcher stdout and use that as rc, or change the CI launcher exit contract and update launcher docs/tests in the same change

what: Failure-log forwarding is gated only by file size, but gh-run-logs writes a header and rc=3 diagnostics
scenario_or_breakage: --failure-log is passed for in-progress or gh-failure captures even though the plan says to omit it, feeding non-failure noise into every tier
suggested_fix: Track gh-run-logs rc separately and forward --failure-log only when rc=0 and the capture has useful content; add rc=3-with-output and rc=1-with-output tests

what: Rollback recipe does not account for files newly added to the index by a failed tier
scenario_or_breakage: A failed Cursor tier can git add a brand-new file; after git restore --staged it becomes untracked but was not in the untracked delta, so it survives into the Codex/Claude tier
suggested_fix: Use or add a named rollback helper that captures staged-added paths as well as tracked/untracked deltas, removes introduced staged additions after unstaging, and add a regression for a failed tier that stages a new file
